item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 22/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a trough of low pressure, there will be heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the coastal areas of Guangdong tomorrow. The trough of low pressure is expected to depart slightly from the coastal areas on Wednesday. There will still be a few showers over the region. Under the influence of a trough of low pressure over the coast of southern China again in the latter part of this week, the weather will be unsettled with occasional thundery showers over the region.

Temp range: 22 - 26 C
